svg.text: DORONA DI VENEZIA — A YEAR OF ATTENTION UNDER LAGOON CONDITIONS
Sap rises as soil warms above 10°C
Tie down canes after winter pruning
Late frost can kill emerging buds
Green, hard, high acid — rapid cell division
Extended skin contact for colour & tannin
Harvest by hand; sort in vineyard
Press and transfer to aging vessel
Optimal: late Sep to mid Oct
Rack and top up aging wine
PHENOLOGICAL DATA: DORONA DI VENEZIA CULTIVAR — ADAPTED FROM VENETIAN LAGOON VITICULTURAL PRACTICE, 1812 NAPOLEONIC CADASTRAL RECORDS, AND CONTEMPORARY VENISSA OBSERVATIONS
